description: Held-out paraphrase questions (written 2026-11-06, before measuring the keyword-search change they check): how-to questions worded unlike their answer pages. Not used to choose or tune any search change; use them to check that a change chosen on godot.json/rails.json generalizes. Same format as godot.json.

queries.query: How do I make my game look right on screens of different sizes?
How do I show the score in the corner of the screen?
How do I make an enemy find its way around obstacles?
How do I make my game run faster when it starts to lag?
How do I remember settings like volume between play sessions?
How do I swap to a running animation when the character moves?
How do I stop the camera from showing outside the level?
How do I let the player collect coins by touching them?
How do I stop the player from walking through walls?
How do I make something happen after a short delay?
How do I keep buttons lined up neatly in a menu?
